items.label: 궁수
items.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Make an ANIMATION SPRITE STRIP of exactly FOUR full-body pixel sprites of the SAME character from the reference, in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, evenly spaced in FOUR equal-width cells. Read this as a four-frame seamless WALK CYCLE ordered 1-2-3-4 then 1 again. Same character proportions approx 2.2 heads tall, clothing colors, hair identity, outline, equipment, pixel scale in all four frames. Authentic crisp large square 16-bit sprite pixels, hard stair-step edges, limited discrete shades, no blur, no glow, no interpolation. Transparent background everywhere outside sprites, no shadows, no scenery, no text or numbers or dividing lines. Whole hair, weapon/equipment and both feet must fit in each cell with wide clear gaps, no overlapping adjacent sprites. Ground-contact feet on SAME horizontal baseline, head orientation stays identical across frames with only tiny natural 1-pixel bob (not head tilting or changing hairstyle). EACH FRAME must depict a different physically plausible pose. Frame1 contact near leg forward / far leg back, FREE near arm back / far arm forward. Frame2 passing: near leg supports weight, far knee passes forward, arms pass middle. Frame3 OPPOSITE CONTACT: near leg back / far leg forward, FREE near arm forward / far arm back; do NOT repeat frame1 upper-body arms. Frame4 OPPOSITE passing, near knee passes forward. Opposite arm and leg swing, no extra limbs, no disconnected hands, no attacking or firing or casting. This strip will later be packed into equal 256x384 cells, do not draw a grid.
ALL FOUR sprites FACE SCREEN LEFT in side profile, walking left in place. Brown tousled hair, navy blue and cream short tunic, brown gloves/belt/boots, quiver on back with cream arrow fletchings, ONE simple wooden bow held low resting in one hand, bow carrier hand naturally restrained; the other arm visibly swings. No shooting/drawing bow. Keep bow/quiver always recognizable and attached.
items.correctionPrompt: Precise sprite-sheet edit. Keep this exact FOUR-sprite horizontal walking strip, transparent background, all four faces left. Edit ONLY THE THIRD SPRITE FROM LEFT (frame3). In frame3 the FREE EMPTY ARM must swing clearly FORWARD to SCREEN LEFT in front of torso instead of remaining behind the body. Draw its shoulder-elbow-wrist connection coherently, empty hand in front of the belt around waist height. The other hand CONTINUES HOLDING its wooden bow with the same grip and equipment. Exactly two arms/hands total, no extra hand, do not drop weapon. Make frame3 the opposite gait contact of frame1: nearer leg back/right, farther leg forward/left. Preserve original head shape/orientation/scale, clothing, equipment design. Keep frames1,2,4 unchanged as closely as possible, keep equal cell positions/gaps/baseline; no new views, no moving hair orientation, no ghost limbs, no background or haze. Maintain coarse crisp square pixel-art shading. This corrects arm/leg alternation; no attacking.
